facts.label: Passivo no presente
facts.sub: Use is/are + particípio para descrever coisas: It is made of wood. It is called Pioneer Hall. Candles are sold there.

facts.label: Feito de
facts.sub: Use is/are made of para dizer o material: It is made of wood. The lamps are made of iron. O material vem depois de of.

facts.label: Chamado

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The passive is be + a past participle.
We say “It is make of wood”.
items.why: We say It is made of wood.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The passive is be + a past participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes: is made.)
We say “It is make of wood”. → Falso (We say It is made of wood.)
“It is called” gives a name. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: An old hall · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cool afternoon in old Seattle. Red brick buildings stand along the street. Zack and Leo walk into a big hall. The air smells like old wood. Light comes through tall windows. Zack starts to talk about the place.
“Look, Leo! This hall is very old.” says Zack. “Wow. What is it called?” says Leo. “It is called Pioneer Hall. It is used for town meetings.” says Zack.
